errors.error_description: Created a sequential always block sensitive to posedge clk and posedge req[0], mixing data input with clock edge and omitting reset from the event list, causing improper asynchronous behavior.
Incomplete combinational assignment to next_grant by providing only an if branch without an else branch, inferring a latch in synthesis.
Implemented grant selection using a deeply nested priority if-else chain instead of structured logic, creating a long combinational path and suboptimal hardware.
Introduced a second continuous driver on the procedural signal 'grant' via a conflicting assign statement, causing multiple active drivers on the net.
